exchange shield for war drum.name: Exchange shield for war drum
exchange shield for war drum.text: A model with a war drum may use it during the Declare Heroic Actions step of each Move Phase to declare a Heroic March for free, without spending a Might Point, even if they are not a Hero. This free Heroic March has the following exceptions: • A model with a war drum that declares a Heroic March must always shout At the Double. • The range of this At the Double is 12" rather than 6". Additionally, friendly models must finish their Activation within 12" rather than 6". • The Heroic March declared when a model uses a war drum will only affect friendly models with the same keywords as the ones shown in brackets after the war drum. So if a model has a war drum (Mordor) then it will only affect models with the Mordor keyword. As a war drum allows a model to declare a free Heroic March, models cannot be affected by both a war drum and a normal Heroic March in the same turn.

scythe gauntlets.text: A Gundabad Troll armed with Scythe Gauntlets increases its Attacks to 4.

exchange shield and spear for mattock.name: Exchange Shield and Spear for Mattock
exchange shield and spear for mattock.text: This is a two-handed weapon. Additionally, if a model wielding a Mattock wins a Duel Roll they may choose to try to knock down an enemy model instead of making Strikes. If they do, choose a single enemy model involved in the Combat. This model and the chosen model both roll a single D6 and add their Strength characteristic. If this model rolls equal to or higher than the chosen model, then the chosen model is immediately knocked Prone. This may be done before any other friendly models make their strikes.

might.name: Might
might.text: When buying the Witch-king for your force, decide how many points of Might/Will/Fate to give him, up to the maximums shown in his profile. At his weakest, the Witch-king starts the game with no Might, no Fate and 10 points of Will, and costs 70 points. Each extra point of Might, Will or Fate costs an extra 5 points, so the Witch-king with 3 Might, 3 Fate and 20 Will points will cost 150 points, before any upgrades.

the oakenshield.name: The Oakenshield
the oakenshield.text: The Oakenshield is a shield. Additionally, should Thorin opt to use it for Shielding during a Fight and he wins, he may make a single Strike at his Strength (receiving no bonuses from any weapons).

armour of gondolin.name: Armour of Gondolin
armour of gondolin.text: This is Unique heavy armour. Additionally, whilst Glorfindel is wearing the armour of Gondolin, enemy Monster models Engaged in Combat with him cannot use Brutal Power Attacks.

mithril coat.name: Mithril Coat
mithril coat.text: This is a Unique piece of Mithril armour. Models cannot use the Rend Brutal Power Attack against a model wearing Mithril Armour. Additionally, the wearer may re-roll Fate rolls of a 1.

gnarled hide.name: Gnarled Hide
gnarled hide.text: The Mumak has a Defence of 8 rather than 7.

foul temperament.name: Foul Temperament
foul temperament.text: The Mumak has 4 Attacks rather than 3; however, it suffers a -1 penalty to its Courage Test when seeing if it will Stampede.

oak.name: Oak
oak.text: The Ent improves its Wounds characteristic to 4.

ash.name: Ash
ash.text: The Ent improves their Shoot Value to 3+ and can still use its Throw Stones special rule even if it has moved that turn (though not if it has Moved over half its Move Value)

full bellies.name: Full Bellies
full bellies.text: Bill, Bert, and Tom increase their starting Might, Will and Fate points to 3

umbrella.name: Umbrella
umbrella.text: This is a hand weapon. If Lobelia wins a Combat, she may not make Strikes.

the one ring (sauron).name: The One Ring (Sauron)
the one ring (sauron).text: Sauron does not follow the normal rules for the One Ring. Instead, each time Sauron would lose his last Wound and be removed as a casualty, roll a D6. On a 2+, the power of the One Ring sustains him and instead of being removed as a casualty he will remain on the board with 1 Wound remaining. If during a Combat Sauron suffers multiple wounds that would cause him to removed as a casualty, he will make this roll for each of them. Sauron may use Might to improve this roll.

kalazâl.name: Kalazâl
kalazâl.text: This is a Unique hand weapon. Múrin gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes against Orc, Goblin or Uruk-hai models.

white sword of gondor.name: White Sword of Gondor
white sword of gondor.text: This is a two-handed weapon. Additionally, Strikes made with a White Sword of Gondor have the Mighty Blow special rule.

bone-breaker.name: Bone-breaker
bone-breaker.text: This is a Unique hand weapon. Enemy models with an Elven weapon Engaged in Combat with, or supporting a model Engaged in Combat with, Razgush do not receive the bonus to the roll-off should the Duel Roll result in a Drawn Combat.

the golden throne.name: The Golden Throne
the golden throne.text: This is a Unique banner. The Golden King does not suffer the -1 penalty to his Duel Rolls for carrying a banner.

westfold redshield.name: Westfold Redshield
westfold redshield.text: Westfold Redshields treat Erkenbrand as a banner.

mithril crown.name: Mithril Crown
mithril crown.text: This is a Unique piece of wargear. friendly Moria Goblin models within 3" of Gróblog gain the Dominant (2) special rule.

durin's axe.name: Durin's Axe
durin's axe.text: This is a Unique Master-forged two-handed weapon. Additionally, this model may re-roll a single D6 when making a Duel Roll.

noldorin daggers.name: Noldorin Daggers
noldorin daggers.text: These are Elven hand weapons, which Erestor may also use as Elven throwing weapons. Erestor may re-roll To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes or when making Shooting Attacks with these weapons.

horn of the hammerhand (erkenbrand).name: Horn of the Hammerhand (Erkenbrand)
horn of the hammerhand (erkenbrand).text: This is a Unique war horn. Additionally, once per game at the start of any Move Phase, Erkenbrand can unleash a fearsome blow of the Horn of the Hammerhand. Until the End Phase of the turn, enemy models within 24" of Erkenbrand suffer a -1 penalty to any Courage Test they are required to make.

pavise.name: Pavise
pavise.text: This is a shield that provides the bearer +3 Defence rather than +1. However, a model with a Pavise cannot gain this bonus to their Defence whilst Engaged in Combat.

whip.name: Whip
whip.text: A whip counts as a throwing weapon with a Strength of l and a range of 2". It can also be used as a hand weapon in a Combat.

swift reload.name: Swift Reload
swift reload.text: When firing the Gondor Avenger Bolt Thrower, you may roll two dice and pick the highest result when determining how many shots it may make.

barazantathûl.name: Barazantathûl
barazantathûl.text: This is a Unique Master-forged two-handed weapon.

tookish hunter.name: Tookish Hunter
tookish hunter.text: Tookish Hunters may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a 1 when making Shooting Attacks.

the warden's sword.name: The Warden's Sword
the warden's sword.text: This is a Master-forged hand-and-a-half weapon.

pitchfork.name: Pitchfork
pitchfork.text: A Pitchfork can either be used as a spear or a two-handed weapon.

horn of the riddermark.name: Horn of the Riddermark
horn of the riddermark.text: This is a Unique war horn. Additionally, Merry gains the Fearless special rule.

torozul.name: Torozul
torozul.text: This is a Unique Foe Spear with the Trollbane special rule. Additionally, Mardin gains an additional bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes against Monster models.

the horn of lossarnach.name: The Horn of Lossarnach
the horn of lossarnach.text: This is a Unique war horn. Additionally, once per game at the beginning of his Activation, Forlong may let out a blast on his horn. If he does, then friendly models within 12" of Forlong count as having the Terror special rule until the end of the turn.

axe of lossarnach.name: Axe of Lossarnach
axe of lossarnach.text: An Axe of Lossarnach can be used as either a spear or a two-handed axe.

smoke bombs.name: Smoke Bombs
smoke bombs.text: These are throwing weapons with a Strength of 1. Any model hit, but not slain, by these weapons must immediately expend a Will Point or suffer the effects of the Transfix Magical Power and have their Fight Value halved until the End Phase of the turn. Should Dalamyr ever roll a 1 To Hit with his Smoke Bombs then his supply has run out and he cannot use them for the remainder of the game.

the serpent banner.name: The Serpent Banner
the serpent banner.text: The Serpent Banner is a Unique banner with a range of 6". Suladan never suffers the -1 penalty to his Duel Rolls for carrying a banner.

breathe fire.name: Breathe Fire
breathe fire.text: The Dragon can Breathe Fire as a shooting attack during the Shoot Phase; treat this as a bow with a range of 12". If the shot hits, then the model that is hit suffers a Strength 10 hit and if they suffer a Wound from this hit, which is not prevented, they are automatically slain. Additionally, all other models (friend and foe) within 2" are immediately Set Ablaze – though they will not be automatically slain if wounded. This is a firebased attack.

fly.name: Fly
fly.text: The Dragon gains the Fly special rule and increases its Move Value to 12" whilst using the Fly special rule.

superior intellect.name: Superior Intellect
superior intellect.text: The Dragon automatically passes any Intelligence Tests it is required to take. Additionally, each time the Dragon spends a Might Point, roll a D6. On a 4+, the Might Point is free and does not reduce the Dragon's store of Might.

wyrm magic.name: Wyrm Magic
wyrm magic.text: The Dragon gains a free Will Point at the start of each turn. If this free Will Point is not spent by the end of the turn, it is lost. The Dragon may also cast the following Magical Powers. Compel (Range 12", Casting Value 3+) Transfix (Range 12", Casting Value 3+) Foil Magic (Range 12", Casting Value 4+)

exquisite mithril armour.name: Exquisite Mithril Armour
exquisite mithril armour.text: This is a set of Unique Mithril Armour that will add 4 to Durin's Defence rather than the usual 3 (already included in his profile).

the ring of durin.name: The Ring of Durin
the ring of durin.text: Once per game during the Priority Phase, after the roll for Priority has taken place, the bearer of the Ring of Durin can re-roll their side's Priority Roll.

the crown of kings.name: The Crown of Kings
the crown of kings.text: This is a Unique piece of wargear. Whenever Durin suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On a natural 6, the Wound is prevented and is ignored.

the horn of zirakzigil.name: The Horn of Zirakzigil
the horn of zirakzigil.text: This is a Unique war horn, which also gives Durin the Terror special rule.

hearthguard.name: Hearthguard
hearthguard.text: Hearthguard have the Burly special rule.

easterling halberd.name: Easterling Halberd
easterling halberd.text: This can be used as either a pike or a two-handed weapon.

helm of the dragon emperor.name: Helm of the Dragon Emperor
helm of the dragon emperor.text: This is a Unique piece of wargear which grants the Dragon Emperor the Resistant to Magic special rule.

the dragon emperor's glaive.name: The Dragon Emperor's Glaive
the dragon emperor's glaive.text: This is a Unique Elven spear. Additionally, the Dragon Emperor may use it to use the Shielding rule even though he does not have a shield. The Dragon Emperor cannot Support whilst mounted upon his Royal Palanquin.
